title: Add RAG agent quickstarts, templates, and tool-calling examples; docs updates
author: Ethan Miller
description: Adds RAG agent quickstarts, RAG templates, and tool-calling examples to redwood-examples and updates the docs site. Motivation: reduce onboarding time for engineers building retrieval-augmented generation and agent/tool-calling patterns by providing opinionated, production-oriented examples and a how-to guide. This PR contains Python and TypeScript quickstarts, templated RAG workflows (indexing, retrieval, prompt templates, eval harness hooks), an agents/examples directory with sample tool adapters (search, browser, calculator) and a docs page with best practices and troubleshooting guidance. Checklist: [x] examples added; [x] docs updated; [x] unit tests and lint passing; [x] smoke e2e quickstart. Related Linear: ENG-4321 DOCS-987. See commits for details.
